Thanks Lydia — helpful. Quick technical checklist from procurement/legal so the PO can be issued as soon as tele-verify completes: 

- Completed W-8BEN-E with the chapter 3 status box filled and the entity FATCA chapter indicated. Please ensure item 10 (GIIN) is left blank if you don’t have one.
- Bank letter must be on bank letterhead, include account number suffix and confirmation of account name, and dated within the last 90 days.
- Signatory evidence: government ID + confirmation that Rajesh Patel is an authorized signatory (board minutes or delegation of authority).
- Beneficial owner declaration (short doc) when the entity is >25% privately held — please confirm if applicable.

Procurement will create a conditional PO (PO-XXXX) and will hold funds pending tele-verify and document acceptance. Once we receive tele-verify confirmation and final PDFs, procurement will flip the PO to active within 48 hours.
